production.notes: Placeholder LAN addresses — set pc_ip and ins_ip for your INS/GNSS UDP source. User presets live in path_presets.json on this PC.

norbit_dct.notes: DCT / high-rate workflow: listen on udp_port; send INS output to pc_ip:udp_port. See docs/NORBIT_DCT.md for field wiring.

cube_mavlink.notes: Edit com to your Cube MAVLink UART (Device Manager). Raw binary, UDP listen 14550. Mission Planner → UDP Client 127.0.0.1:14550. Use Presets → Load (not list click alone). See docs/OPERATOR_GUIDE.md §5.6.

cube_gps_uart.notes: ArduPilot GPS injection via dedicated UART. Set com to the Cube UART port connected to this PC (e.g. Telem2). ArduPilot params: SERIALx_PROTOCOL=5 (GPS), SERIALx_BAUD=38 (38400), GPS_TYPE2=5 (NMEA). NMEA sim or INS sends UDP to this PC:10110 → bridge forwards over UART → Cube treats it as a secondary GPS. Run alongside Cube MAVLink instance for parallel MAVLink relay + GPS injection.
